name: Stoneham Park
description: Two play areas: one with a sandpit and a mural, best for younger children, and one in the main park with bigger climbing equipment, swings and slides. There's a community café (hours vary) and a ball court, and the park is flat with accessible paths. The nearest accessible toilet is at Hove Museum.
